name: kept-vault
description: Your private Kept vault: your trading journal, keys and replay data, in your own Cloudflare account.

DB.description: Your private journal database. Cloudflare creates it for you.

VAULT_PASSWORD.description: Make up a password (8+ characters). You'll type it into Kept to open your journal. Save it somewhere safe.

DATABENTO_KEY.description: Optional. Your Databento API key (starts with db-) for trade replay. Type none to skip. You can add it later.

ANTHROPIC_KEY.description: Optional. Your Anthropic API key (starts with sk-ant-) for AI review. Type none to skip. You can add it later.

APP_ORIGINS.description: The Kept website allowed to open your vault. Leave this as it is.
